exposure: positive family history of diabetes mellitus
history of miscarriage more than once
cohort: Palestinian refugee women in the Gaza Strip
finding: The most significant risk factors for GDM were history of miscarriage more than once, overweight before pregnancy, history of stillbirth, history of caesarean birth, and positive family history of diabetes mellitus.
mod_finding: History of caesarean birth was a significant risk factor for GDM.
